newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural soars on share split, capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural soars on share split, capital increase.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Gas Natural shot up on Tuesday after the announcement of a four-for-one share split and a capital increase to be charged to reserves.
At 0900 GMT, Gas Natural was up 900 pesetas, or 3.12 percent, to 29,780 while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was 1.34 percent to 6,670.69.

"Gas Natural has followed the recent trend by splitting shares, which is good in that it should eradicate the illiquidity premium with which it was trading," said Javier Borrachero, analyst at Central Hispano Bolsa brokerage.
"But this doesn't change the fundamental valuation of the company," he added.
Other dealers said the stock's gain on the cancellation of that premium should be between two and four percent.
Short term, Gas Natural is not expected to gain much more, but in one to two years the shares could rise to 34,000-35,000 pesetas, analysts said.
After the split, due to be approved by shareholders on June 18, the number of shares will rise to 149.3 million from 37.3 million.
